e: Transfer of funds from one object to supplement funds for another object — that is the right answer. This is the fact laid down for the situation described in the question. This provision exists for a practical reason in day-to-day railway working; keeping that practical picture in mind makes the fact far easier to retain than memorising it in isolation. The remaining options describe different situations or commonly confused alternatives — none of them fits the specific facts asked here. Make a one-line note of this — it is the kind of direct question that rewards quick, confident recall.

A useful way to verify this in the exam hall is to ask what would break if the opposite were true — the logic of the underlying system points straight to this option.
